title: Garlicky Spaghetti with Spinach
description: Spaghetti tossed in golden garlic olive oil with chili flakes, lemon and wilted spinach.

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of well-salted boiling water until al dente, about 10 minutes. Save 1 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
While it cooks, warm the oil and garlic together in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Cook gently until the garlic is pale gold, 3 to 4 minutes, then add the pepper flakes.
Add the spaghetti, the spinach and about ½ cup of the pasta water. Toss over the heat until the spinach wilts and the sauce turns glossy, adding more water if it looks dry.
Finish with the zest and juice of the lemon and a pinch of salt. Serve topped with parmesan.
